meta.title: Jarvis HUD
meta.description: Black and charcoal HUD skin with dark-gold accents for the DSH web client. It recolors surfaces, borders, focus and selection, replaces the sidebar and blank-session brand marks, plays an arc-reactor boot sequence, and adds a balance readout in the composer status row. Use Settings → General → Jarvis HUD to switch the skin, choose the boot tempo, set the boot policy or replay the sequence; the skin is presentation only and sends nothing to external services. Light mode stays a neutral light-gray variant.
